placements.why: This envelope's entire content is a calibration record for an observatory instrument — frequency setting confirmed against reference plates. No existing strata category exists in this repo yet, and this content names exactly the organizational category 'Calibration' from the org's ratified taxonomy; nothing supplied covers it, so it is minted standalone with no forced parent.
placements.title: instrument calibration and verification as an organizational category
placements.frame: does this content record an instrument being brought into and confirmed at a working calibration state?

placements.title: an instrument's calibration is trustworthy because it was checked against a named reference standard
placements.frame: what reference standard or prior baseline is this calibration being checked against, and does the verification claim hold across the full operating range?
placements.why: All three segments describe the same recurring subject: the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration value stated and then validated by comparison against the June reference plates, holding across the observing band. This is a theme future calibration envelopes will keep feeding (new instruments, new reference sets, re-verifications) rather than a one-time fact — it names the recurring practice of grounding a calibration claim in a reference-standard check, not the specific 88.4 MHz figure itself. No existing narrative leaf exists in this repo to hold it, so it is minted under the newly-placed Calibration strata.
